title: billing.debit
description: Payload for the billing.debit comm Function — service-to-service wallet debit (wrapper over stapel_billing.services.debit). idempotency_key is REQUIRED: comm delivery is at-least-once and a retry with the same key returns the original transaction instead of debiting twice. Returns {"ok": bool, "balance": int|null, "reason": str|null, "transaction_id"?: str}. allow_partial (default false) switches the all-or-nothing charge for a partial one: the wallet is charged what it has, the uncovered remainder is recorded as a CreditDebt that the wallet's next top-up collects, and the answer carries requested/debited/shortfall/debt_id. It is for the consumer that has ALREADY done the work — without it the only options were refusing a completed job or giving it away with nothing recording that it was given away. type values mirror stapel_billing.models.TransactionType.
